testimonials.title: Our clients
testimonials.intro: Every project is unique, like every person we accompany. Here are some of the results we have achieved together.

taktikum.description: They were looking for a solid digital presence more than new clients. We created valuable content and a new feed design more coherent with their identity and the way they work, boosting engagement.

equazenes.description: We created the profile from scratch, designed the content and managed the community. Their growth is organic and follows a clear line aligned with their objective, just like the rest of the brands we work with.

totterapia.description: We reactivated their social media with a coherent strategy, video recording and editing, and a presence across every social network. Within a few months they are growing organically, and every week messages arrive from people interested in their services.

intuity.description: We optimised their Instagram, applied a clear strategy and left a solid foundation so they could keep growing on their own. They now manage their day-to-day socials while Cosmo keeps editing their reels, maintaining the visual coherence and the quality of the content.
highlights: +23% more engagement on their edited reels

carousel.text: Working with Cosmo has been liberating. I finally have time for my patients without feeling like I'm neglecting my online presence. Laia understands exactly what I want to convey.
They don't just manage my Instagram, they do it with a sensitivity few agencies have. You can tell they know the mental health world. My community has grown organically and genuinely.
Cosmo helped me find my voice on social media. Before, I felt lost; now I have a digital presence that truly represents me. And without dedicating a single minute of my time.

reviews.title: What our clients say
reviews.intro: Real testimonials from professionals who have transformed their digital presence

ignacio.text: I worked with Laia for a year and the experience was exceptional. She stands out for her strategic vision, her analytical skills and, above all, her impeccable execution. Beyond the professional side, she is a very warm person with deep personal development work that is directly reflected in the quality of her work and in how she accompanies others. If you are considering hiring her, my recommendation is clear: don't hesitate for a second.

pablo.text: Working with Laia is a real pleasure. Thanks to her we have been able to give structure and momentum to our communication, gaining fluency, coherence and clarity. She accompanied us with great professionalism through marketing and advertising processes, making everything easy and efficient. She is pragmatic, responsible and deeply committed to what she does. You can tell she gives 100% and cares about every detail. We are very happy to keep collaborating together.

anna.text: Working with Laia has been very easy and pleasant from the start. She understood from the very first moment what Taktikum is and how we wanted to communicate, respecting the tone, values and sensitivity of the project. She is engaged, organised and has excellent judgement when creating content, always with a careful and coherent eye. On a personal level, she brings us peace of mind, professionalism and trust, and that is key in a project like ours.

bruno.text: Laia brings a great combination of strategic judgement and sensitivity. She has helped us communicate more precisely and make better decisions, always from a clear, practical perspective aligned with our values. A professional, well-focused collaboration.
